Elements.title: Elements
Elements.description: If the program is being delivered in segmented form this describes each segment's content, position and offset from the start of the program as well as other embedded content such as inserted barter content

Series.title: Series
Series.description: If the content is part of a series this allows the entry of the episodic information

ProgramContract.description: If the program is purchased, it may be linked to a rights contract

ParentalRating.description: Parental rating for the show for one region (PMCP)

ContentType.title: ContentType
ContentType.description: Used to describe the type of content (e.g. network, local, entertainment, news) (See Configuration Section in BXF Protocol Documentation) (v3.0)

EiCode.title: EiCode
EiCode.description: Used for FCC Education/Information Children's code. (v3.0)
